utility.notes: The City of Redding has operated its own municipal electric utility for over 100 years (celebrated its centennial in 2021), confirmed via the city's own REU pages. This is a municipal utility, not PG&E, independently confirmed rather than assumed from county location.

generation_supplier.notes: No Community Choice Aggregator was found serving Redding this session; as a municipal utility, REU generally would not participate in a CCA the way IOU-served cities do.
